title: 3 Kesalahan Video Produk HP yang Bikin Orang Tidak Jadi Beli

slides.headline: Video Produk HP Kamu Terlihat Murahan?
slides.body: Masalahnya mungkin bukan di harga HP kamu, tapi pada 3 kesalahan teknis dasar yang sering tidak disadari ini.
slides.image_prompt: Split screen visual comparing a dull dimly lit smartphone product video on the left versus a sleek high-end aesthetic product shot on the right, dark modern studio theme
slides.layout: Centered strong headline with high-contrast comparison background visual

slides.headline: 1. Lighting Asal-Asalan
slides.body: Mengandalkan lampu kamar bikin warna produk kusam dan bayangan berantakan. Solusi: Gunakan cahaya alami dekat jendela atau diffuser sederhana.
slides.image_prompt: A smartphone on a tripod filming a product next to a bright window with soft diffused daylight, aesthetic minimalist setup
slides.layout: Headline top, text on the left, clean light lighting diagram visual on the right

slides.headline: 2. Cuma Pakai Satu Angle Monoton
slides.body: Menonton video 15 detik dari satu sudut diam bikin penonton cepat bosan dan scroll away. Variasikan jarak kamera untuk menjaga visual hook.
slides.image_prompt: Minimalist graphic chart showing 3 phone camera angle icons: Establishing shot, Medium shot, and Macro close-up shot focused on a product
slides.layout: Top headline with 3-column horizontal feature breakdown below

slides.headline: 3. Pergerakan Kamera Terlalu Cepat
slides.body: Gerakan HP yang terlalu cepat dan patah-patah bikin penonton pusing serta gagal melihat detail penting produk kamu.
slides.image_prompt: A modern smartphone mounted on a sleek gimbal stabilizer smoothly panning around a luxury product on a polished dark table
slides.layout: Clean side-by-side split layout with text on left and dynamic image on right

slides.headline: Gunakan Formula 4-Shot Sederhana Ini
slides.body: Gabungkan 4 shot dalam 10 detik: 1. Establishing Shot (Konteks), 2. Medium Shot (Bentuk), 3. Macro Shot (Tekstur/Detail), 4. Action Shot (Penggunaan).
slides.image_prompt: A 2x2 grid photo collage showing four cinematic video angles of a product: wide contextual view, product medium shot, extreme close-up texture, and hands using the product
slides.layout: Top headline with 2x2 image grid layout labeled with shot types

slides.headline: Mau Video Produk Kamu Terlihat Kelas Atas?
slides.body: Kirim footage mentah HP kamu, Bos Sony Creative Studio yang ubah jadi video promosi berkelas iklan profesional. Klik link di bio!
slides.image_prompt: Sleek professional creative studio mockup background with a prominent Call to Action button aesthetic and smartphone preview showing polished video editing timeline
slides.layout: Centered bold CTA card layout with dark navy and gold creative studio aesthetics
